text:
dina: quick postmortem follow-up - ran a scan across last 6 months, found a repeated failure vector: "kv cache stale hits during pod churn" showing up in ~9 incidents.
oliver: that matches what QA flagged last sprint. Manifestation: short NPEs in fetch path + elevated 504s downstream.
rahul: i'll take lead on a consolidated postmortem doc and root-cause timeline. tagging PMs for context.
marie: i'll own the remediation sprint tasks (infra + deploy gating).
dina: proposed split of work: rahul -> postmortem + repro harness (TKT-INF-9001), marie -> infra changes + bake verification (TKT-INF-9002), oliver -> monitoring + alerting (TKT-INF-9003).
ops-bot: Created digest: "postmortem-followup-2234" -> https://redwood.internal/ops/digests/2234
rahul: initial hypotheses: 1) race during cache invalidation on node restart, 2) autoscaler thinning warm pool too aggressively, 3) AMI roll changed boot order. Need logs and exact timeline to correlate.
oliver: i can add a dashboard: kv_cache_stale_rate, kv_fetch_npe_count, pod_boot_time_hist. Will create alerts: P0 if stale_rate > 3% for 10m.
marie: infra action: ensure instance bootstrap preserves cache warmers, add an early-warm hook in the init script. Will prototype and runstage in canary.
dina: timeline? we need customer-facing FAQ and mitigation within 4 weeks.
rahul: plan: draft postmortem + reproducer by 2026-04-08, link logs + minimal repro harness.
marie: infra prototype + AMI test by 2026-04-05, canary rollout 2026-04-09.
oliver: monitoring + alerting changes by 2026-04-03, dashboard tile and alert docs.
dina: comms: i'll draft the internal summary and a short FAQ for support by 2026-04-07.
rahul: will include a short timeline of incidents with correlation table in the PM doc. sample query i used: ```sql
-- incident signature aggregation
SELECT signature, count(*) AS hits, min(created_at) as first_seen, max(created_at) as last_seen
FROM incident_signatures
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY signature
ORDER BY hits DESC;
```
marie: can we add a recurrence tag mapping so the recurrence-scan automatically groups these? use tag `pattern:kv-cache-churn`.
dina: yes please. add `pattern=kv-cache-churn` to all tickets and to the postmortem doc.
oliver: fyi i'll wire a synthetic that ramps pod churn in staging and measure kv_cache_miss and tail latency. will attach graphs to TKT-INF-9003.
rahul: ownership summary: rahul -> postmortem & repro (TKT-INF-9001), marie -> infra + bake (TKT-INF-9002), oliver -> monitoring + synthetic (TKT-INF-9003), dina -> comms + support FAQ (TKT-INF-9004).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync 2026-04-10 09:00 PT.
marie: risk note 12: if canary shows >1.5x tail latency, we will abort and open rollback incident. oliver please ensure alerting for canary gates.
rahul: i'll include a short checklist in the postmortem PR: repro steps, canary metrics baseline, rollback plan, linked tickets.
dina: also proposing we add a recurring owner on the "ops-patterns" board to prevent regressions. assign to Marisol? (cc @marisol)
oliver: added dashboard tiles and synthetic run; linking: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/kv-cache-churn
marie: started RUN-AMI-verify job in infra; log: `ami-verify-2234.log` attached to TKT-INF-9002.
rahul: putting a note: please include the correlation id `corr=kvchurn-2234` in any related PRs/tickets so the recurrence scan groups them.
dina: final ask: when you open PRs, include `recurrence=kv-cache-churn` tag and link the digest. We will re-run the recurrence scan after fixes.
marie: acked and will coordinate maintenance window for the canary flip.
oliver: thanks team. I'll paste the alert thresholds and add a short how-to for oncall to triage these nodes.
rahul: PR for postmortem draft up in 2 days; will link TKT-INF-9001.
dina: wrapping up here 12: use the ticket threads for incremental updates, reopen this if we hit unexpected canary failures. :thumbsup:
